'''Keevo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], Keevo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vollen Sor]], the pair was dispatched to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[3653 BBY]] as part of the Republic's delegation to a [[Alderaan peace conference|summit]] called by the Empire. While on Alderaan, the Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacked]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and forced the Republic to sign a [[Treaty of Coruscant|treaty]] which ended the war. Master and Padawan were in the [[Eeseen spaceport]] when rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] was preparing to leave Alderaan to avenge her [[Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], who had recently [[Death/Legends|died]] at the hands of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. When Sor asked her what she was doing, she simply stated that she was doing something for Zallow. Sor, Keevo, and Leneer talked for a while in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and Leneer said farewell and prepared to leave. Sor and Keevo followed her to her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to find out what she was doing, but Leneer would not tell them before departing the world.<ref name="TORD" />
